scope: portrait plus four cardinal directions only; diagonal delivery not assembled

review.direction_and_gait: Front-facing. Frames 1/3 put opposite screen-side boots forward; frames 2/4 lift opposite knees and retain the other boot as ground support. Distinct contact/passing/opposite-contact/opposite-passing order.
review.identity: Consistent accepted compact mature-faced ink/jade chibi, high ponytail and kite; no changed body proportion by processing.
review.edges: Full light/dark composites and leg crops inspected. Hair/kite strings, boots and red/jade accessories complete; no continuous visible magenta outline or bright leg-gap key pocket. Remaining color-count candidates include dark outlines and original warm accents; numeric hue count alone is not an art defect.
review.limitations: Four-frame hand-painted walk; no skeleton or engine playback validation.
